subject: general
question: Which specific environmental awareness campaign was carried out by the Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP) team during its first all-women expedition to Mt Everest in 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Clean Himalaya — Save Glacier**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP)** successfully completed its **first-ever all-women** international mountaineering expedition to **Mt Everest** (8,848 m) on **May 21, 2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The 14-member team conducted the **“Clean Himalaya — Save Glacier”** campaign as part of their historic mission.
 
• During this campaign, the team carried out **environmental awareness activities** and collected **non-biodegradable waste** in the Everest region.
 
• The summit was achieved via the **South Col Route** from the Nepal side, with the first summit recorded at **0652 hrs**.
 
• The expedition team consisted of **11 women climbers** and **3 technical/support members** who negotiated the **“Death Zone”** above 8,000 metres.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The **ITBP** has now completed **232 mountaineering expeditions** in total, including **five** successful summits of **Mt Everest**.
 
• The Force has also scaled six of the world’s fourteen 8,000-metre peaks: **Mt Everest**, **Mt Kanchenjunga**, **Mt Makalu**, **Mt Lhotse**, **Mt Dhaulagiri**, and **Mt Manaslu**.
 
• The expedition was flagged off on **April 19, 2026**, from **Force Headquarters, New Delhi**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• This expedition was conducted in line with the **Union Home Minister’s** vision to hold exclusive **ITBP Everest expeditions** for three consecutive years.
 
• This achievement reflects **ITBP’s** commitment to **women empowerment**, **adventure leadership**, and excellence in **high-altitude operations**.
